text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One holiday. Hearing there was a speed climbing competition, I went to watch.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Pyu~ pyu-pyu~♪
All right, let's do this!
choice_data_list: Are you participating in the tournament too?
Are you entering the tournament as well?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Of course, I'm aiming for victory!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to take on the challenge too—
just like Line Craft-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: That's right. Craft-senpai is the reason I'm standing here today!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~?!
You won a climbing tournament...?!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, yeah! In both bouldering
and lead climbing.

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: I was good at rock climbing to begin with, so I entered thinking maybe I could pull it off.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, amazing~!
And a double crown on top of that! That's a full-mile perfect score!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: Actually, apparently it was the first time anyone achieved a double crown in the tournament's horse girl division.

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: It feels like I'm blazing an uncharted trail with my very own hands!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
!
...Blazing a trail, huh...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: My heart started blazing up with passion...! That's why I decided I had to try too!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: My goal is for a complete climbing beginner to win! That's an unprecedented record nobody has ever achieved before!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yup! Just watch me, I'm pretty good at sports!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Teryaryaryaryaryaaaa~!

text_block_list.name: Tournament Announcer
text_block_list.text: Gran Alegria breaks through the qualifiers! Fast, incredibly fast~!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, feeling good♪
I'm gonna keep this momentum going all the way~!
choice_data_list: That didn't look like beginner movement at all...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I can just tell! Climbing like this is definitely the fastest way up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that, Gran Alegria continued to advance through the qualifiers with her phenomenal athleticism. And finally—

text_block_list.name: Tournament Announcer
text_block_list.text: At last, the final round! Facing off are the promising newcomer Gran Alegria... and the double crown champion Line Craft!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
Gran-chan!
I was surprised to see you make it all the way to the finals!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... I want to blaze an untrodden path myself!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: No matter how difficult, I'll take it on! Let's have a great match, Craft-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
!
...Yeah, I'm not backing down either!

text_block_list.name: Tournament Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Who will scale the wall first—
And the match has started!

text_block_list.name: Gran & Craft
text_block_list.text:
—Yaaaaah!!
—Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I can reach it...! I'll definitely, definitely grab hold of it!!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
I've made it this far—
I'm going to take first place!

text_block_list.name: Tournament Announcer
text_block_list.text: Both competitors reached the top almost simultaneously! The winner is—

text_block_list.name: Tournament Announcer
text_block_list.text: Line Craft! A margin so razor-thin it could only be judged by slow-motion replay! What a breathtaking dead heat!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh. Urrgh...!
Just a tiny bit more!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Still... congratulations!
You won, you're the champion!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...! Thank you!
That was an amazing match, truly!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: Your straightforward passion to carve out a new record really reached me.

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
Give it your all, Gran-chan.
...Because I know you can blaze your own path!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: —Yes! Someday, I'll definitely reach my very own summit!
